sn48.38:2.2: Yaṃ kho bhikkhave kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ kāyikaṃ sātaṃ kāyasamphassajaṃ sukhaṃ sātaṃ vedāyitaṃ ||
sn48.38:3.2: Yaṃ kho bhikkhave kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ kāyikam asātaṃ kāyasamphassajaṃ dukkham asātaṃ vedayitaṃ ||
sn48.38:4.2: Yaṃ kho bhikkhave cetasikaṃ sukhaṃ cetasikaṃ sātaṃ manosamphassajaṃ sukhaṃ sātaṃ vedayitaṃ ||
sn48.38:5.2: Yaṃ kho bhikkhave cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ cetasikaṃ asātam manosamphassajaṃ dukkham asātaṃ vedayitaṃ ||
sn48.38:6.2: Yaṃ kho bhikkhave kāyikaṃ vā cetasikaṃ vā neva sātaṃ nāsātaṃ vedayitaṃ ||
sn48.38:7.1: Tatra bhikkhave yaṃ ca sukhindriyaṃ yaṃ ca somanassindriyaṃ sukhā sā vedanā daṭṭhabbā || ||
sn48.38:7.2: Tatra bhikkhave yaṃ ca dukkhindriyaṃ yaṃ ca domanassindriyaṃ dukkhā sā vedanā daṭṭhabbā || ||
sn48.38:7.3: Tatra bhikkhave yadidam upekhindriyaṃ adukkhamasukhā sā vedanā daṭṭhabbā || || 9.
sn48.38:7.4: Iti kho bhikkhave imāni pañcindriyāni pañca hutvā tīni honti || tīni hutvā pañca honti pariyāyenā
